# Third party code in this directory

`driver.js.iife.js` and `driver.css` are the distribution build of **Driver.js**, version **1.8.0**,
taken straight from the `driver.js` package on npm. They are vendored here rather than pulled from a
CDN or built by a bundler, so the plugin has no build step and the control panel makes no request to
anybody else's server.

- Library: Driver.js
- Version: 1.8.0
- Home: https://driverjs.com
- Source: https://github.com/kamranahmedse/driver.js
- Licence: MIT

Nothing in either file has been modified.
